subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic plugin Hooks events such as `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed`, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or a cross-channel contract with a shared payload?
rationale: This changes the public plugin API and overlaps with existing system-event and reaction-wake paths, so automation should not choose names, payload shape, or scope without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Generic Reaction Hooks
options.body: Add observation-only `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` hooks with a structured payload and wire Discord as the first implementation while keeping the contract usable by other channels.

options.title: Ship Discord-Only Hook First
options.body: Add a Discord-specific hook quickly, accepting a later migration or compatibility burden if other channels need a different shape.

options.title: Use System Events Only
options.body: Document reaction system events and heartbeat usage as the supported plugin path, avoiding a new hook but leaving this requested direct observation surface unimplemented.

recommendation.title: Define Generic Reaction Hooks
recommendation.body: Add observation-only `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` hooks with a structured payload and wire Discord as the first implementation while keeping the contract usable by other channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history points to steipete on the plugin SDK/system-event boundary and Discord reaction-adjacent maintenance, making him the best routing owner for the API direction choice.
